fusions.name: Nectar Run
fusions.desc: Sends 3 foragers out from your blossom in a spread out to 6 tiles; each one deals 3 poison damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wax-Sap Clot
fusions.desc: Throws a clot of sap and comb that deals 11 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Blossom Flush
fusions.desc: Brings you into flower where you stand. For 8 seconds the blossom restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles. A swarm escort drawn to it fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Honey Tithe
fusions.desc: Each time you gain health, a sting leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
